Airman Automotive | Dealer Alternative Repair | top of page | Home | Services | Contact | Call us | Log In | AIRMAN | AUTOMOTIVE | Auto Care Excellence | at Your Fingertips | Get a Quote | BOOK MOBILE SERVICE > | Our Journey In The Automotive Industry | About Us | ​ | Welcome to Airman Automotive, your premier automotive service center located in the heart of Jupiter & West Palm Beach, Florida. With over 40 years of experience and a passion for all things automotive, we are dedicated to providing top-notch repairs and maintenance for all vehicle makes and models. | Our skilled technicians utilize the latest technology and techniques to ensure your vehicle runs smoothly and safely. From routine oil changes to complex engine repairs, we pride ourselves on our commitment to quality, integrity, and customer satisfaction. | At Airman Automotive, we believe in building lasting relationships with our clients through transparency and exceptional service. Whether you’re a local resident or just passing through, we treat every vehicle as if it were our own. Visit us today and experience the difference in automotive care! | Top-Tier Services | for Your Vehicle | From maintenance to customization, we’ve got you covered. | See all services | Full Vehicle Diagnostics | Airman Automotive Diagnostic Service specializes in comprehensive vehicle diagnostics to identify and resolve issues efficiently. Using advanced diagnostic equipment and skilled technicians, the service provides detailed assessments of engine performance, electrical systems, emissions, and more. Whether it's a check engine light, unusual noises, or performance drops, Airman ensures accurate problem identification, enabling timely repairs and optimal vehicle performance. Their commitment to quality and customer satisfaction makes them a trusted choice for automotive diagnostic needs. | ​ | Engine Repair and Overhaul | Airman Automotive specializes in high-quality engine repair and overhaul services, ensuring optimal performance and longevity for your vehicle. Our experienced technicians utilize advanced diagnostic tools and techniques to identify issues and provide efficient, reliable repairs. Whether you need a complete engine rebuild or a minor tune-up, Airman Automotive is committed to delivering exceptional craftsmanship and customer satisfaction. Trust us to get your engine running smoothly again, so you can hit the road with confidence! | ​ | Brake Services | Airman Automotive is your go-to destination for top-notch automotive care, specializing in comprehensive brake services. Our expert technicians are dedicated to ensuring your vehicle's braking system operates safely and efficiently. We offer thorough inspections, replacements, and maintenance, utilizing high-quality parts to enhance performance and longevity. With a commitment to exceptional customer service and a focus on keeping you safe on the road, Airman Automotive makes brake care convenient and reliable. Trust us to keep your brakes in prime condition for optimal driving confidence. | Real Stories from Our | Satisfied Customers | "This was my first visit to Airman Automotive and a test to see if I could rely on them for good car service in the future. I needed some routine service but also diagnostics and fixes for check engine and airbag warning lights. They were able to accomplish all of these tasks within a day as I had requested and Chris and Victoria were pleasant, helpful, and friendly as well. They passed the test given by this demanding reviewer and as a result I will rely on them for my future car repair needs." | Dave H | "We have been using Christian’s services for over a year now. We have taken an older Jeep Wrangler, 2004 Honda Accord, and now our 2014 Jeep Grand Cherokee to him and his team. | He and his team of mechanics are very honest, helpful, knowledgeable, and communicative. Whenever issues have been raised, he has always made them right. | Christian and his team are a rarity in the automotive industry! They are truly the best!" | Janell Kroeger | "Airman Automotive is reliable, honest and operated with integrity. I recommend them to anyone who is looking for some great mechanics.
